Thank you for sharing your experience.

We’re sorry to hear how difficult this situation has been for you, and we completely appreciate how challenging prolonged waiting times can feel.
At the time you were under our care, you were assessed and referred appropriately in line with NHS guidelines. Once a referral is accepted, appointment scheduling and treatment timelines are managed by the hospital trust, and unfortunately GP practices do not have control over secondary care waiting lists or the speed at which treatment is started.

We are committed to ensuring that referrals are made safely and promptly when clinically indicated, and we truly wish you the best with your ongoing treatment and recovery.

Regards
